new_cards.desc: During the Damage Step, if an opponent's monster attacks your monster: Target 1 other face-up monster you control; your attacked monster gains ATK equal to that target's ATK, during the Damage Step only.
strings: Make your attacked monster gain ATK

new_cards.name: Mystic Swordsman LV4
new_cards.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned (but can be Normal Set). At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a face-down Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Mystic Swordsman LV6" from your hand or Deck.

new_cards.name: Re-Fusion
new_cards.desc: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Fusion Monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, banish the equipped monster.

new_cards.name: Dark Mimic LV1
new_cards.desc:
FLIP: Draw 1 card.
Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can send this card to the GY; Special Summon 1 "Dark Mimic LV3" from your hand or Deck.
strings: Special Summon 1 "Dark Mimic LV3" from your hand or Deck

new_cards.name: Monster Reincarnation
new_cards.desc: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster in your GY; add it to your hand.

new_cards.name: Mind Haxorz
new_cards.desc: Pay 500 Life Points. Look at your opponent's hand and all Set cards on their side of the field.

new_cards.name: Flint
new_cards.desc: The equipped monster loses 300 ATK and cannot change its battle position or declare an attack. If this card is destroyed because the equipped monster is destroyed: Target 1 monster on the field; equip this card to that monster.

new_cards.name: Tricky Spell 4
new_cards.desc: Send 1 face-up "The Tricky" you control to the Graveyard; Special Summon "Tricky Tokens" (Spellcaster-Type/WIND/Level 5/ATK 2000/DEF 1200) in Defense Position, equal to the number of monsters your opponent controls. "Tricky Tokens" cannot declare an attack.

new_cards.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV4
new_cards.desc: Control of this face-up card cannot switch. During the End Phase, if this card destroyed a monster by battle this turn: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" from your hand or Deck.

new_cards.name: Poison Fangs
new_cards.desc: Each time a Beast-Type monster inflicts Battle Damage to your opponent, inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

new_cards.name: Trap of Darkness
new_cards.desc: If your LP is 3000 or less: Pay 1000 LP, then target 1 Normal Trap in your GY, except "Trap of Darkness"; this card's effect becomes that target's activated effect, then banish that target.
strings: Select a Normal Trap Card in your Graveyard

new_cards.name: Nightmare Penguin
new_cards.desc: All face-up WATER monsters you control gain 200 ATK. When this card is flipped face-up: Target 1 card your opponent controls; return that target to the hand.

new_cards.name: Red Gadget
new_cards.desc: When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Yellow Gadget" from your Deck to your hand.
strings: Add 1 "Yellow Gadget" from your Deck to your hand

new_cards.name: Skull Dog Marron
new_cards.desc: A lost dog that wandered off 1000 years ago. He's still waiting for his master to come for him.

new_cards.name: Firebird
new_cards.desc: Each time a Winged Beast-Type monster(s) on your side of the field is destroyed, this card gains 500 ATK.

new_cards.name: Watapon
new_cards.desc: If this card is added from your Deck to your hand by a card effect: You can Special Summon this card.

new_cards.name: The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
new_cards.desc: Add 2 "LV" monsters from your Graveyard to your Deck and shuffle it.

new_cards.name: Sorcerer of Dark Magic
new_cards.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 2 Level 6 or higher Spellcaster-Type monsters, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. During either player's turn, when a Trap Card is activated: You can negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

new_cards.name: The Earth - Hex-Sealed Fusion
new_cards.desc: You can substitute this card for any 1 Fusion Material Monster, but the other Fusion Material Monster(s) must be correct. You can Tribute Fusion Material Monsters on the field, including this face-up card; Special Summon 1 corresponding EARTH Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck.

new_cards.name: Fox Fire
new_cards.desc:
Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card is in the GY because it was destroyed by battle and sent there this turn: Special Summon this card. This face-up card cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

new_cards.name: Hallowed Life Barrier
new_cards.desc: Discard 1 card; you take no damage from your opponent's cards this turn, also your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

new_cards.name: Pitch-Black Warwolf
new_cards.desc: Your opponent cannot activate Trap Cards during the Battle Phase.

new_cards.name: Greed
new_cards.desc: Each time a player draws cards because of a card effect, they take 500 damage during the End Phase for each card drawn by the card effect.

new_cards.name: Ninjitsu Art of Decoy
new_cards.desc:
Activate this card by targeting 1 "Ninja" monster you control; it cannot be destroyed by battle.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.
strings: Make 1 "Ninja" monster you control indestructible by battle

new_cards.name: Tactical Espionage Expert
new_cards.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned successfully, no Trap Cards can be activated.

new_cards.name: Abare Ushioni
new_cards.desc: Once per turn, you can toss a coin and call it. If you call it right, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent. If you call it wrong, you take 1000 damage.

new_cards.name: Familiar Knight
new_cards.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Each player can Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from their hand.
strings: Special Summon 1 Level 4 monster from your hand?

new_cards.name: Taunt
new_cards.desc: Activate only during your opponent's Main Phase 1; select 1 monster on your side of the field. While the selected card remains on the field, if your opponent attacks with a monster(s) this turn, they must select the selected monster as the attack target.

new_cards.name: Raging Flame Sprite
new_cards.desc: This card can attack directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: It gains 1000 ATK.

new_cards.name: Enraged Muka Muka
new_cards.desc: Gains 400 ATK/DEF for each card in your hand.

new_cards.name: Unshaven Angler
new_cards.desc: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of a WATER monster.

new_cards.name: Mecha-Dog Marron
new_cards.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, inflict 1000 damage to both players. When this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard except by battle, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

new_cards.name: Kangaroo Champ
new_cards.desc: A monster that battles with this card is changed to Defense Position after damage calculation.

new_cards.name: Catnipped Kitty
new_cards.desc: This card cannot be attacked if there is another Beast-Type monster on your side of the field. Once per turn, you can make the DEF of 1 monster on your opponent's side of the field 0 until the end of this turn.

new_cards.name: Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon
new_cards.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "Red-Eyes Black Dragon". Gains 300 ATK for each Dragon monster in your GY.

new_cards.name: The Creator Incarnate
new_cards.desc: You can Tribute this card; Special Summon 1 "The Creator" from your hand.

new_cards.name: Element Valkyrie
new_cards.desc:
(This card is not treated as a "Valkyrie" card.)
This monster gets the following effect(s) while there is a monster(s) with the following Attribute(s) on the field:
●FIRE: This card gains 500 ATK.
●WATER: Control of this card cannot switch.
